QUOTE: "the two calls are a size probe followed by a fill, not retry. Nothing in the tokenizer retries a failure."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the two calls as size negotiation (probe then fill) rather than retry-on-failure, and notes the second call runs unconditionally with no retry. It never says "no backoff" or "no attempt counter" in so many words, but it states the substance.
